name: pi-outliner
description: Pi Outliner integration for Claude Code: typed outline, workboard and door tools for agents (read, find, edit, comment, changes, draft.patch, ep0ch act), clickable references, and completed responses that mention [[pages]], ((block ids)) or Work IDs in the Outliner's Recent Mentions navigator.

workspaces.title: Outliner workspaces
workspaces.description: Absolute project directories whose sessions and subdirectories feed Recent Mentions, separated by ':' or ','. The nearest configured ancestor selects the workspace. Empty: PI_OUTLINER_MENTIONS_WORKSPACES applies; neither set, nothing is ingested.
